shadcn.note: Commit of the shadcn@4.22.1 release tag, matching the pinned CLI; skills/shadcn is unchanged from there to main (8ab2771, 2026-11-08).
patches: allowed-tools narrowed from `npx|pnpm dlx|bunx --bun shadcn@latest *` to `pnpm -C apps/back dlx shadcn@4.22.1 *`: never pre-approve an unpinned CLI
`npx shadcn@latest` (and the pnpm dlx/bunx variants) replaced with `pnpm -C apps/back dlx shadcn@4.22.1` throughout; vindotski note added (back only, shared tokens in packages/theme)
the `!`npx shadcn@latest info --json`` context injection, which ran an unpinned CLI every time the skill loaded, replaced with an instruction to run the pinned `info --json` first
allowed-tools narrowed from `npx|pnpm dlx|bunx --bun shadcn-svelte@latest *` to `pnpm -C apps/front dlx shadcn-svelte@1.7.1 *`: never pre-approve an unpinned CLI

`npx shadcn-svelte@latest` (and the pnpm dlx/bunx variants) replaced with `pnpm -C apps/front dlx shadcn-svelte@1.7.1` throughout; vindotski note added (front only, shared tokens in packages/theme, `--preset <style name>` needs CLI 1.8.0+)
`npx @sveltejs/mcp` replaced with `pnpm dlx @sveltejs/mcp@0.1.27`: an exact, mature version instead of whatever is newest at run time
